summary: The documentation update is factually consistent with the four campaign records and their manifests. It keeps evidence limits explicit and makes no unintended acceptance claims. The history entries match the records: GPU scaling at 5.075/7.558/9.341/9.842 GiB/s with independent results review not performed; the psana stripe screen with count 1 at 5.443 GiB/s, NIC bytes not collected and review pending; the C++ reader with count 2 at 12.92 and count 1 at 11.42 GiB/s at 40 threads, five OSTs, independent review passed, backend cache uncontrolled; and SDF with seven allocations and 48 configurations, four BDs total fixed, inputs partially transferred, the last three cohort reviews and the synthesis review pending. The assessment separates execution, archive verification and independent results review. It keeps the required distinctions: local versus backend cache, whole-NIC versus storage traffic, reader rate versus a single-OST ceiling, and GPU count rising together with BDs and CPU. It states that it is not a new results verdict or a baseline qualification. Its SDF gap figures (8 of 17 inputs absent, 156 rows, 48 cells) agree with the archive records. The retirement prerequisites in the assessment and in step 5 of IMPLEMENTATION.md agree, and both treat missing NIC data and pending reviews as non-blocking. Validation artifacts are present and record passing results. One low-severity, non-blocking finding concerns stale wording in status.json.

The 1.94x speedup supports the assessment's 'nearly twice'.

All match the history row and the assessment.

SDF gap figures are consistent across archives/scaling-20261116/sources/README.md (nine inputs present, eight not transferred), scaling_migration_20261116/README.md and context-01.md (156 rows and 48 cells).

context-01.md line 93 scopes the migration review to 'scientific summaries'. That supports the assessment's statement that the consolidation reviews checked summaries and arithmetic. review-02.json confirms the scientific qualifications carried forward unchanged.

The performance overview README adds only the assessment link paragraph. The relocation.json entry for docs/performance/README.md remains integrated/original-addition. I did not recompute its destination hash; this relies on migration.log.

Step 5 and the 'Historical evidence follow-ups' section of IMPLEMENTATION.md agree with the assessment: retirement prerequisites, optional recovery and focused review, and no recovery or review performed.
No text upgrades an execution, implementation or migration review into results acceptance or baseline qualification. Missing observations remain labelled unavailable or pending.
